prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton California?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objectively “best” personal-injury lawyer in Pleasanton—best depends on your injury, insurance limits, whether liability is disputed, and whether the case may need trial.

For a strong Pleasanton/East Bay choice, prioritize a lawyer who:

- Regularly handles your type of case (car crash, pedestrian, slip-and-fall, wrongful death, etc.)
- Has actual trial experience in Alameda and Contra Costa Counties—not just settlement advertising
- Works on contingency and clearly states the percentage and case-cost arrangement
- Has no relevant discipline listed with the [California State Bar](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/)
- Is a California Certified Specialist in Personal Injury Law, if available for the lawyer you’re considering
- Will personally review your case rather than immediately passing it to a case manager

Interview 2–3 firms and ask: “How many cases like mine have you taken to trial?” “Who will handle my file?” and “What happens to costs if we lose?”

Be careful with firms that promise a dollar amount before reviewing medical records, coverage, and fault evidence.

Also, don’t wait: California’s general deadline is usually **two years** from injury, but a claim involving a city, county, state agency, or public vehicle can require a government claim in as little as **six months**.

If you tell me what happened—such as auto collision, Uber/Lyft crash, fall, dog bite, or work-related injury—I can help you identify what qualifications and questions matter most for that specific case.
